# Navigator half-subscribes a list whose eventSource is not in the DOM

## Context

`test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingPickerProjection.spec.mjs:80` ("combo, vertical") failed once on #20631's `e2e-engine (2/14)` at `8c6dc4c486` (job 128914786847). The re-run passed, and `dev`'s own E2E at `6247654d3e` passed the arm. Besides "Escape ended the edit", the arm logged two page errors:

```
pageerror: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'addEventListener')
    at Navigator.subscribe (src/main/addon/Navigator.mjs:536:25)
pageerror: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'removeEventListener')
    at Navigator.unsubscribe (src/main/addon/Navigator.mjs:555:30)
```

## The Problem

`Neo.main.addon.Navigator#subscribe` resolves `subject` (the list) and `eventSource` (the element its keys come from), and checks only `subject`. A combo's picker list takes keys from the field input (`ComboBox#createPickerComponent`: `navigator: {eventSource: me.getInputElId()}`) and floats on the body. The field's DOM can leave before its picker does, because `Picker#afterSetMounted(false)` hides the picker in a later update. A list subscribe that lands in that gap finds the list but not the input. It sets `subject.$navigator`, attaches its observers, and throws on `eventSource.addEventListener`. The list's later unmount finds the half-subscription and throws on `data.eventSource.removeEventListener`.

Measured with a real `list.Base` in the component viewport whose `navigator.eventSource` names no element: on `dev` the mount throws the same `addEventListener` error and leaves `$navigator` on the list element. A control list whose `eventSource` exists subscribes normally.

Locally the combo arm passed 20/20. A probe that parked the picker list's subscribe until the input left saw the list leave in the same mutation batch, so the gap depends on timing (CI load).

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/main/addon/Navigator.mjs` `subscribe(data)`: `subject = DomAccess.getElement(data.id)`, `eventSource = data.eventSource ? DomAccess.getElement(data.eventSource) : subject`, then `if (subject) {...}`.
- `src/list/Base.mjs` `afterSetMounted` subscribes on mount and unsubscribes on unmount. `ComboBox` and `Time` set `navigator.eventSource` to their input.
- Design authority: `Navigator#subscribe`'s JSDoc, `@param {String} [data.eventSource]`: "the element id to read keystrokes from". A subscription without that element can read no keys.

## The Fix

`subscribe` subscribes only when both `subject` and `eventSource` are in the DOM, and otherwise does nothing. The list's next mount (the next picker show) subscribes again. `unsubscribe` stays as it is: without a half-subscription there is nothing for it to trip on.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A list whose `navigator.eventSource` is not in the DOM mounts and unmounts without a page error, and carries no `$navigator`.
- [ ] That spec fails on `dev` with the `addEventListener` error.
- [ ] A list whose `eventSource` is in the DOM still subscribes, as the same spec's control.
- [ ] `CellEditingPickerProjection.spec.mjs` and the list and combo component specs pass.

## Out of Scope

- Re-subscribing a mounted list when its `eventSource` returns later. No current flow keeps the list mounted through its field's absence: the picker hides with its field.
- Whether "Escape ended the edit" has a cause beyond these throws. It failed together with them once and passed 20/20 locally.
